card.name: Words introducing a predisposing condition
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "with", "of", "were" and "risk" that come right before a predisposing condition or vulnerable group, especially in warnings about who is susceptible to a reaction.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "if", "once" and "inherently" (mostly Chinese) and "predis", so it pushes toward predisposition and conditional wording.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a risk factor or susceptible condition is named, as in "a patient with narrow angles".
